compatibility_notes: The supplied nozzle tree contains 8 standard Rain Curtain nozzles with a 25 degree trajectory and 4 low-angle nozzles with a 10 degree trajectory.
installation_constraints: 3/4 inch NPT female bottom-threaded inlet. Radius may be reduced up to 25 percent with the nozzle retention screw.
notes: 5004 is the 4 inch pop-up model; PC identifies reversing part-circle adjustment from 40 to 360 degrees. The CSV contains the requested standard-angle nozzle tree. Published precipitation rates are based on half-circle operation and zero-wind testing.
